title: No admin sweep for misattributed vectors inside a still-mapped partition
wanted_capability: bbox_embed_partitions prunes only whole unmapped partitions. When bucket attribution changes (2026-07-11: markdown language=md mislabel plus the enqueue/backfill rule split routed prose chunks into the voyage_code partition for ~20 minutes, ~10K vectors), the wrong-partition vectors persist as unattributed residue that neither backfill nor compaction removes: they inflate active_count and double-represent entities in the wrong vector lane. Want a scrub action (partition x current-attribution diff -> delete entities whose attributed route differs), dry-run default, reusing embed_iterate_internal + the shared is_code_chunk rule.
fallback_used: Accepted the ~10K stale vectors as benign double-representation; nightly compaction keeps the partition healthy otherwise.
evidence: voyage_code partition active_count vs code bucket source_count delta
resolution_note: Shipped as bbox_embed_partitions action="scrub" (commit 59ff27a6): classifies every vector in a mapped partition against current attribution via the shared is_code_chunk rule, dry-run default, deletes on apply; index-missing and non-project_file rows always kept. Executed on voyage_code 2026-07-11: 90,377 examined, 4,870 misrouted prose vectors deleted, 0 errors; voyage_text dry-run clean.
